text.tspan: Film one swing.
Get the lesson
card back.
AIcoach watches one down-the-line clip and tells
you what the fault is, where it comes from, how
sure it is, and what to practise: one drill and
one mobility exercise. If the video can’t support
an answer, it says so.
Checks three faults for now: early extension, loss of
posture and over the top. Practice tool only, not for use
during a competitive round.
“It may feel like you stay down, but at impact your
hips have moved toward the ball.”

g.text: Practise: Wall drill, 3 × 10. 90/90 hip rotation, 2 × 8 each side.

text.tspan: Every verdict comes from a fixed rule table with set
thresholds. Anything outside it is labelled unverified and
never gets a drill.
Early
extension
Your hips move toward the ball
on the way down, so you stand
up out of your posture.
Hip movement toward the ball,
address to impact.
Loss of
posture
The angle you set at address
changes during the swing: you
rise up or dip down.
Change in posture angle, address to
impact.
Over the
top
From the top, the club starts
down outside the line it went
back on.
Hand path on the way down.

svg.text: Three steps, all from your phone at the range.

text.tspan: Prop your phone at hand height, 2.4 to 3.7
m behind your hands, pointing along the
target line. Use 120 fps if your phone has
it.
One swing per clip, mp4 or mov, up to 15
seconds. You decide whether it is saved to
your swing library.
“It may feel like you stay down, but at impact your
hips have moved toward the ball.”

g.text: Practise: Wall drill, 3 × 10. 90/90 hip rotation, 2 × 8 each side.

text.tspan: The fault, where it comes from, how sure
the app is, and one drill plus one

svg.text: It says when it isn’t sure

text.tspan: AIcoach would rather give you no answer than a wrong one. Every
measurement carries its confidence, and it refuses to guess on video
it can’t read.

svg.text: We didn’t guess. Here’s what to change:

text.tspan: Face-on view detected. Film from behind,
down the line.
Feet out of frame. Get your whole body and
club in.
Filmed at 30 fps. Use 120 fps if your phone
has it.
No verified fault
found
All three rules were checked. None
crossed its threshold, so there is no
drill.
Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.
A clear view of the body parts it
measured.
Partly hidden, or measured
indirectly.
Treat it as a hint. Film again
before you change anything.
Ask the pro about
your lesson
Under every result you can ask questions in
plain words. The pro answers only from your
analysis: no new faults, no made-up numbers,
no drills from nowhere.
If your question goes beyond what the video
measured, it tells you to ask a coach.

g.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.

text.tspan: Why does it feel like I’m staying down when I’m
not?
Your upper body barely changed: your posture angle moved only 6°, so
it feels like you stay down. What moved is lower. In your impact
frame your hips are 7% of your body height closer to the ball than at
address.

svg.text: Bring one swing to the counter.

text.tspan: AIcoach is a practice tool, not for use during a competitive round.
Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
Results shown on this page are synthetic examples.
